summary: Official warnings state that Ribociclib can lead to severe, life-threatening, or fatal lung inflammation known as interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, so doctors must watch for new or worsening breathing symptoms [3]. Additionally, one clinical study combining Ribociclib with other drugs was stopped early because of a high risk of harmful side effects [5]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M].
